get_freejoint: get the free joint of a MuJoCo body element or return None if absent
get_attachment_frame: get the attachment frame of an MJCF model from its parent model
get_frame_freejoint: get the free joint of an MJCF model attachment frame
get_frame_joints: get all joints belonging to an MJCF model attachment frame
commit_defaults: commit default attribute values from dclass hierarchy into a PyMJCF element
